# Wind for Mac keybind rules: one case per line, "<bind text> <verdict>".
# Read by Tests/WindCoreChecks (Binds.swift bindVerdict, `swift run wind-checks`) and by
# ui/tests/keybind-rules.nodetest.mjs (ui/src/lib/keybindRules.js, `npm run test:rules`), so the two
# rule sets cannot drift. "invalid" means parseBind cannot read the text.
# Verdicts: ok, empty, mousebutton, modifier, needsmod, cmdalone, opttypes, invalid.

# The defaults (Config.swift) are all allowed.
ctrl+opt+left ok
ctrl+opt+right ok
ctrl+opt+up ok
ctrl+opt+down ok
cmd+escape ok
ctrl ok

# Parsing: aliases, case, spaces, order, the "+" key.
opt+ctrl+left ok
CTRL+OPT+EQUAL ok
control+option+equal ok
alt+ctrl+equal ok
command+ctrl+a ok
ctrl + opt + z ok
ctrl+opt+= ok
ctrl+opt+- ok
ctrl+opt+plus ok
ctrl++ ok
ctrl+opt+esc ok
ctrl+ invalid
ctrl++opt invalid
+a invalid
a+ctrl invalid
ctrl+nope invalid
ctrl+opt+mouse invalid
mouse invalid
mouse0 invalid
mouse1 invalid
mouse32 invalid
mouse-3 invalid
ctrl+a+b invalid

# Mouse buttons: 2 and up, any modifiers or none.
mouse2 ok
mouse5 ok
mouse31 ok
shift+mouse3 ok
ctrl+mouse4 ok
cmd+mouse2 ok
ctrl+opt+shift+cmd+mouse4 ok

# Modifier-only (the wheel zoom modifier).
opt ok
shift ok
cmd ok
ctrl+opt ok
ctrl+shift ok
ctrl+opt+shift+cmd ok

# A modifier key (caps lock is one) as the key.
capslock modifier
ctrl+capslock modifier
ctrl+opt+capslock modifier

# F keys stand alone, with any modifiers.
f1 ok
f5 ok
f12 ok
f13 ok
f18 ok
f19 ok
f20 ok
shift+f13 ok
cmd+f1 ok
opt+f18 ok
ctrl+opt+shift+cmd+f17 ok

# Typing and other keys need ctrl, opt or cmd.
a needsmod
z needsmod
1 needsmod
equal needsmod
space needsmod
return needsmod
tab needsmod
escape needsmod
delete needsmod
forwarddelete needsmod
left needsmod
up needsmod
home needsmod
pageup needsmod
help needsmod
keypad1 needsmod
keypadenter needsmod
keypadclear needsmod
shift+a needsmod
shift+left needsmod
shift+escape needsmod
shift+keypad5 needsmod

# cmd plus one key is an app shortcut.
cmd+c cmdalone
cmd+q cmdalone
cmd+equal cmdalone
cmd+left cmdalone
cmd+space cmdalone
cmd+keypad1 cmdalone
cmd+shift+z ok
cmd+opt+z ok
ctrl+cmd+z ok

# opt (with or without shift) plus a typing key types a character.
opt+a opttypes
opt+e opttypes
opt+z opttypes
opt+0 opttypes
opt+9 opttypes
opt+equal opttypes
opt+minus opttypes
opt+leftbracket opttypes
opt+rightbracket opttypes
opt+quote opttypes
opt+semicolon opttypes
opt+backslash opttypes
opt+comma opttypes
opt+slash opttypes
opt+period opttypes
opt+grave opttypes
opt+space opttypes
opt+keypad0 opttypes
opt+keypadplus opttypes
opt+keypadequals opttypes
opt+plus opttypes
shift+opt+a opttypes
opt+shift+equal opttypes

# opt with keys that do not type, or with ctrl or cmd, is fine.
opt+left ok
opt+up ok
opt+escape ok
opt+return ok
opt+tab ok
opt+delete ok
opt+home ok
opt+keypadenter ok
opt+keypadclear ok
shift+opt+left ok
ctrl+opt+a ok
ctrl+opt+space ok
cmd+opt+a ok
ctrl+opt+shift+a ok
ctrl+a ok
ctrl+space ok
ctrl+left ok
ctrl+shift+1 ok
